independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.ar: الاستقلال 1 يناير 1956 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 43)
independent-sudan-first-parliamentary-pe.quote: The Sudan gained independence from British-Egyptian rule on 1 January 1956.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: The role of Islam in Sudan, and Sudan's identification as an Arab or African state, are questions that have been open since independence in 1956.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: May 1969: officers led by Colonel Nimeiri take power (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: مايو 1969: ضباط بقيادة العقيد نميري يستولون على السلطة [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: ...in May 1969 a group of officers led by Colonel Gaafar Mohamed Al-Nimeiri took power.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14

also.quote: ...or the 1983 attempt of the Nimeiri military dictatorship (1969-85)--to apply Islamic law, or shar'ia , to the south.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: Addis Ababa Agreement, February 1972 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: اتفاقية أديس أبابا فبراير 1972 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: In February 1972 Nimeiri signed the so-called Addis Ababa agreement with rebels from the south, which provided for a kind of autonomy for the south. This agreement made peace possible for the next 11 years.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: The conflict was punctuated by an autonomy agreement in 1972 that ended the first civil war between southern separatist forces and the central government, then headed by President Jaafar Nimieri, a military dictator.

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: September 1983 Shariah rule; second war with the south begins 1983 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: تطبيق الشريعة سبتمبر 1983؛ بدء الحرب الثانية مع الجنوب 1983 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.19, para 45)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: ...in September 1983 ... Nimeiri introduced Shariah rule. All of these steps led to strong reactions in the south, and eventually to the start of the second war with the south in 1983.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14; Glossary

also.quote: ...or the 1983 attempt of the Nimeiri military dictatorship (1969-85)--to apply Islamic law, or shar'ia , to the south. | Glossary: Anya-Nya II rebel south Sudanese forces who, together with former members of the Sudanese army, formed the SPLA in 1983

nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.en: April 1985: Nimeiri government overthrown (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.ar: أبريل 1985: الإطاحة بحكومة نميري [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
nimeiry-era-democratic-republic-of-sudan.quote: Finally, in April 1985, after 16 years in power, the military Government of Nimeiri was overthrown in a military coup organized by army officers

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers)

also.quote: Popular movements, engaging in strikes and street demonstrations, almost without bloodshed overthrew two military governments in 1969 and 1985.

cite_extra.caveat: Source sentence says '1969 and 1985'; only 1985 is used here. Historian review advised.

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Elections 1986; Sadiq Al-Mahdi Prime Minister (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.ar: انتخابات 1986؛ الصادق المهدي رئيسًا للوزراء [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)
transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: Elections were organized in 1986, which led to the victory of the Umma party’s leader, Sadiq Al-Mahdi, who became Prime Minister.

cite.pages: Introduction and Summary (HTML, no page numbers), note 14

also.quote: ...whether the present one, the prior democratic one (1986-89), or the 1983 attempt...

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.en: Transitional Military Council under General Siwar Al-Dahab (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.20, para 46)

transitional-third-parliamentary-period.quote: ...a Transitional Military Council was put in place under the leadership of General Abed Rahman Siwar Al-Dahab.

al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.en: Darfur conflict: incidents from February 2003; ICC arrest warrant for President al-Bashir, 4 March 2009 (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.2)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.ar: نزاع دارفور منذ فبراير 2003؛ مذكرة توقيف من المحكمة الجنائية الدولية بحق البشير 4 مارس 2009 [يحتاج تحقق] (UNSC_S2005_60 PDF p.2)
al-bashir-ncp-ingaz-regime.quote: ...it focused in particular on incidents that occurred from February 2003

cite_extra.quote: 4 March 2009 ... The International Criminal Court (ICC) today issued an arrest warrant for war crimes and crimes against humanity committed in the strife-torn Darfur region by Sudanese President Omar Al-Bashir, the first sitting Head of State to be indicted by the Court.

second-parliamentary-period.quote: ...in 1963 an armed rebellion emerged. ... The transitional Government held elections in April and May 1965. A coalition Government headed by a leading politician of the Umma party, Mohmmed Ahmed Mahjub, was formed in June 1965.
